spots.name: Whitetail Reservoir
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 111 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L3508682.

spots.name: Four Buttes
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 791 m (2,595 ft).
